title: Japanese Face Solo #39 (일본 · 30대 · 냉혹한 · 메이크업 반바(강화) · 피어싱 P25+쥬얼리 · 렌즈 오렌지 파이어(고양이눈) · 태운 피부)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Japanese woman — Japanese poised refined beauty deeply sun-tanned bronze-brown skin with a warm glossy sheen, mid 30s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, sleek black shoulder-length hair with a side part. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and lime paint strokes across the cheekbones, rhinestone and star stickers clustered on the cheeks and forehead only, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, vivid fiery orange coloured contact lenses with a vertical slit cat-eye pupil, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, a cold narrowed stare without a trace of warmth straight through the camera, brows low and still, lips pressed in a thin flat line, an icy, ruthless, merciless expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight pieces — a big bronze bar in the lobe, three smaller bronze rings above it, two thick bronze bars and two small bronze studs up to the top; one small bronze stud sits in the right ear; four bronze pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small bronze rings pass through the left nostril and a thick bronze septum ring hangs below the nose; a bronze hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a bronze snake-bite ring beside it and a small bronze ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a bronze Medusa stud sits above the lips; a bronze labret stud and a small bronze ring sit on the chin; three small bronze studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small amethysts set into the metal. All jewelry is real bronze, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Jewelry: besides the piercings she wears four to six pieces, layered of rose-gold necklaces and chains resting on her neck and collarbones, and four to six pieces, layered of rose-gold hair ornaments set in her hair, all of it real, without covering her eyes, her face or her piercings.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
